##### Project general facts

Sylvana by Reportage Properties is an exceptional residential development in Istanbul that combines modern luxury, beautiful Italian-inspired architecture, and peaceful green surroundings. The project features 232 spacious four-bedroom townhouses, thoughtfully designed to offer families an elegant, comfortable, and private living experience.

Residents of Sylvana can enjoy a fantastic selection of amenities, including landscaped gardens, BBQ areas, modern gyms, children's play areas, basketball courts, and chess areas. The gated community also offers shaded seating areas, private and guest parking, and 24/7 security, creating a safe and relaxing environment for the whole family.

Each townhouse features high-quality finishes, stylish interiors, and carefully planned living spaces that combine elegance with everyday comfort. The homes come with fully tiled bathrooms, modern kitchens with cabinets and countertops, built-in wardrobes, double-glazed windows, private balconies, and dedicated parking spaces, providing everything needed for a comfortable lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Istanbul is a vibrant and captivating city that brings together European elegance, Asian charm, and a rich cultural heritage. Its unique atmosphere, stunning waterfront views, and remarkable architecture create an inspiring setting for residents seeking a dynamic and fulfilling lifestyle.

The city offers an excellent range of shopping malls, restaurants, cafés, schools, healthcare facilities, and entertainment venues, ensuring comfort and convenience in everyday life. Its extensive public transportation network, including metro lines, ferries, and buses, makes it easier to travel between different districts and explore the city.

Surrounded by the beauty of the Bosphorus, green parks, and scenic coastal areas, Istanbul offers plenty of opportunities for relaxation and outdoor activities. With its lively cultural scene, diverse dining options, and year-round attractions, the city provides an appealing balance of modern urban living and timeless charm.
